title: Good Night
label: ch:ta-good-night
canDo: I can say good night in Tamil out of roots I already own, and trace every one of those forms back to நல்.

payoff.summary: Say nalla iravu and iravu vaṇakkam, then run nal- forward into nalam, naṉṟi and nalla.
payoff.note: This chapter gained TA-W10-read-naan when the writing strand was extended to cover the glyphs chapters 2-3 had been explaining inline, and the payoff was not widened to match, so representativeness fell from 2/3 to 2/5 and this chapter joins payoffsNotRepresentative. That is the same trade chapter 13 records. Widening it means authoring a payoff that assesses both the good-night vocabulary and the ா sign, which is HL-C25 work.
